shortDescription: Chase Sapphire Reserve's monthly $10 DoorDash credit now requires a $20 minimum purchase on pickup orders. "High-End Credit Cardholders Find It's Harder to Get Their Money's Worth," at 9 p.m. ET on Aug. 30, mistakenly omitted that the minimum-purchase requirement applies only to pickup orders.
